answer: Reaching the cipher of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The gale lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vertex is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, idle agents bleed standing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
